answer_1.quote: Given an input query, the retriever first identifies relevant evidence text, upon which the generator then generates the answer... CFIC involves encoding a document into transformer hidden states... subsequently generating grounding text.
answer_1.outputs: generated grounding text evidence (supporting passages) and final answers for QA tasks

answer_2.quote: We use F1-score as the evaluation metric.

answer_3.quote: We tasked ChatGPT with determining the faithfulness of the generated text evidence to the long documents and assessing the extent to which the evidence supports the query.
methods: prompted evaluation of faithfulness and support

answer_4.quote: We had two human annotators blindly rate the quality of text evidence generated by different models.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to rate the quality of the generated text evidence, considering aspects such as faithfulness to the source and usefulness for answering the query.
